mapper.select: SELECT code, label, icon, sort_order FROM tab_def ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tab_def WHERE code = #{code})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_tab_label (project_id, tab_code, label) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{tabCode}, #{label}) ON CONFLICT (project_id, tab_code) DO UPDATE SET label = EXCLUDED.label
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_tab_label WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND tab_code = #{tabCode}
